# Traffic Engine AI — Complete Reference (https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/)

Repository: https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine
License: MIT
Primary Runtime: Node.js LTS (Express dashboard on 127.0.0.1:4310) + Docker Compose (swarm & lightpanda profiles)

## Core Dependencies (package.json)
- crawlee ^3.18.2
- playwright ^1.58.2
- patchright ^1.64.3
- camoufox ^0.5.9
- rrweb ^2.2.2
- @lightpanda/browser ^1.2.0 (optional CDP sidecar)
- fingerprint-generator & fingerprint-injector ^2.1.90

## Quickstart Commands
```bash
git clone https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine.git
cd ai-organic-traffic-engine
npm install
npm --prefix dashboard install
npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
cp config.example.json config.json
cp .env.example .env.local
npm start
```

## Offline Zero-Spend Verification Suite
- `npm test` (tests/redaction.js)
- `node tests/verify-plan.js`
- `node tests/verify-proxy-resolution.js`
- `node tests/verify-proxyscore.js`
- `node tests/verify-residential.js`
- `node tests/signup-release.js`
- `node tests/verify-engine.js chromium`
